metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Iris Dripcount
records.biography_en: Iris Dripcount joins Geological Complaints as stalactite witness. “Another drop. Mark it down.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short pointed calcite head ornament and chunky three-bead drip counter.

records.name: Gus Faultline
records.biography_en: Gus Faultline joins Geological Complaints as indignant fault keeper. “It was lined up yesterday.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two offset rock slabs held close with one stubby measuring rod.

records.name: Bram Fossilwait
records.biography_en: Bram Fossilwait joins Geological Complaints as long-waiting fossil. “Take your time. I have.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small large-spiral fossil half exposed in a clay matrix held in both hands.

records.name: Tess Corecheck
records.biography_en: Tess Corecheck joins Geological Complaints as geology sample inspector. “The good layer is in the middle.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short striped cylindrical drill core.

records.name: Alf Basalt
records.biography_en: Alf Basalt joins Geological Complaints as keeper of hexagonal columns. “They grew that way.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small group of three blunt hexagonal basalt prisms.

records.name: Perry Pebbleage
records.biography_en: Perry Pebbleage joins Geological Complaints as confused erosion clerk. “It used to be bigger.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one smooth rounded pebble and a miniature plain balance pan.
